Definition: properly, to urge; by implication, to inflict a penalty, specifically, to fine
BiblicalUsage: 1) to fine, amerce, punish, condemn, mulct; 1a) (Qal) to fine, punish; 1b) (Niphal) to be fined, be punished, be mulcted
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
